acceptance_plan: Static IN and NOT IN preserve equality/coercion and SQL three-valued NULL semantics.
IN (SELECT ...) is lowered into a streaming two-input membership/join path without changing the outer output schema.
Outer and inner INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, duplicate, NULL, and batch transitions emit correct downstream changes.
Multiple/nested membership predicates and residual filters preserve planner semantics.
Focused SQL-to-DAG tests and a deterministic event oracle cover arrival-order and retraction cases.
Provide the short demo video required by the Algora bounty instructions.
YAML config accepts a WASM UDF variant and generated schema covers it.
SQL expression planning resolves a configured WASM scalar function through supported projection, filter, and aggregation paths.
Runtime executes a deterministic numeric scalar ABI with checked conversions and SQL NULL propagation.
Invalid module, export, arity, type, trap, fuel, and memory cases fail deterministically.
Feature-off builds remain clean; WASM feature wiring compiles through expression, SQL, and CLI crates.
Repo-native tests cover config deserialization, expression execution, processor behavior, and regression builds.
Provide the short demo video required by the Algora bounty instructions.

effort_bound.planning_basis: Config/schema model, feature wiring, WASM runtime integration, SQL expression planning, native tests, fixture/example, CLI build and required demo artifact.
